title: DOW-UAP-D74, Mission Report, Syria, November 2023
doc_notes: This is a declassified Department of War mission report from November 2023 containing a recorded UAP encounter by military personnel.

encounters.summary: Military aircraft observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon shaped like a bouncy ball traveling at 424 knots for seven minutes.
encounters.entity_behavior: maintained 424 knots, dropped altitude, passed aircraft
encounters.quote: observed 1x prob hc uap shaped as a bouncy ball
